fusions.name: Drowsy Bolt
fusions.desc: Throws a heavy bolt that deals 10 damage, stuns the target for 0.8 seconds and has an 80% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Settling Weight
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy stomp that deals 32 damage to one enemy and always lands as a critical hit. It leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stilled Glade
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Digest
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 8% and you regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.
